About Global Health

Company boilerplate

Global Health is an online healthcare service connecting patients with registered doctors for video consultations, medical certificates, prescriptions and laboratory tests. The service operates in Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Czechia, Romania and Brazil, with consultations delivered in the local language and in English.

In Spain, consultations are delivered by doctors registered with Colegio Oficial de Médicos. Global Guest s.r.o. (IČO: 19071680), registered in Czechia

You are welcome to reuse this description verbatim in your reporting.
